plan.angle: The top 10 splits into network how-tos (ClickBank, impact.com), screenshot galleries (saaslandingpage, Leadpages, GetResponse, Partnerize) and builder roundups (Voluum, Swipe Pages). They show what the page looks like and stop at the button. This page defines the affiliate landing page for the AI Overview, then covers the parts that decide whether a commission is counted and trusted: the disclosure placement the FTC describes, rel=sponsored on merchant links, a tracking ID per button and a click table to set against the network report. Four tabs cover both sides of the link: three publisher formats and the merchant's own program page.
tab_stories: Switchback Trail Notes reviews one backpacking stove per page, puts a one-line disclosure under the headline before any Check price button, and tags each of its three buttons with its own tracking ID.
Kettlebrook Coffee Guide compares three burr grinders under $200 in one table, and last week's 812 outbound clicks split 406, 270 and 136 across the three tagged buttons.

Pantry Pick Deals lists a meal-kit brand's codes behind a Show code button that reveals the code, opens the store through the tracked link and logs the reveal, and codes with no reveals in 30 days come off the page.

Inkwell Invoicing's affiliate program page states a 25% commission for 12 months and a 60-day cookie, and applicants who plan paid search go to Odalys for manual review while the rest are approved by email.

claims_to_source: An affiliate landing page sits between a traffic source and the merchant's sales page, and its goal is clicks on the affiliate tracking link (also called a bridge page)
The FTC says an affiliate disclosure works best close to the recommendation, readers may miss one at the bottom of a page, and a hyperlinked disclosure is easily avoided
Google asks sites in affiliate programs to mark affiliate links with rel=sponsored
Google's spam policies treat affiliate pages that copy the merchant's descriptions with no added value as thin affiliation, and name original reviews, testing and comparisons as added value
ClickBank lets affiliates add a tracking ID (TID) to a HopLink, reports which TID led to each sale, and a dash breaks the TID
A cookie window is the period after a click in which a sale is still credited to the affiliate (ClickBank uses 60 days)
